name: Pomona
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Pomona, CA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Pomona, CA: the City Hall Holiday Lighting Ceremony and the free Downtown Pomona Holiday Parade with Holiday at the Plaza.
lede: Pomona lights up the season with a City Hall lighting ceremony and a free downtown parade that ends at a holiday plaza party.
celebrates: The City of Pomona lists its Holiday Lighting Ceremony and Holiday at the Plaza on its official calendar, and Downtown Pomona runs the Holiday Parade on the second Saturday of December. The ceremony kicks off the season at Pomona City Hall on December 7. Five days later the parade rolls down Second Street at 6 pm, and families stay for food and entertainment at Shaun Diamond Plaza until 9 pm.
lastyear: Downtown Pomona's parade page keeps photo galleries from the 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024 parades, which shows how long the second Saturday of December has belonged to the Holiday Parade. The 2026 parade is scheduled for December 12 at 6 pm, free and open to everyone.
facts: The Downtown Pomona Holiday Parade starts near Centennial Park at Gibbs and Second Street, cruises down Second Street, heads down Park Avenue and wraps up near Mission Boulevard and Garey Avenue. The city calendar lists Holiday at the Plaza at Shaun Diamond Plaza, 195 West Second Street, from 3 to 9 pm on the same day.
trains: RailGiants Train Museum at the Fairplex in Pomona is open free on the second weekend of each month, with its next open weekend on December 12 and 13, 10 am to 5 pm. The museum's host page lists no Christmas program, so treat it as a train stop on the same weekend as the parade rather than a Santa train. The Fairplex Garden Railroad is open free on December 13 from 11 am to 4 pm. For Santa trains, see our California Christmas train rides guide.
train_links: Free locomotive cabs to climb at Fairplex on the second weekend of the month, December 12 and 13 from 10 am to 5 pm.
traditions: The City of Pomona's season kickoff at City Hall on December 7.
A free parade on the second Saturday of December, with entries along Second Street.
Food and entertainment at Shaun Diamond Plaza, continuing after the parade until 9 pm.
kidfact: The Downtown Pomona Holiday Parade always takes place on the second Saturday of December.
faq: When is the Pomona Holiday Lighting Ceremony in 2026?
The City of Pomona lists the Holiday Lighting Ceremony on Monday, December 7, 2026, from 6 to 9 pm at Pomona City Hall, 505 S Garey Ave.
When is the Downtown Pomona Holiday Parade in 2026?
The parade is on Saturday, December 12, 2026, at 6 pm. Downtown Pomona says it is free and open to everyone, and Holiday at the Plaza continues afterward at Shaun Diamond Plaza until 9 pm.
Are there Christmas train rides in Pomona?

Not a Christmas train ride. RailGiants Train Museum at Fairplex is open free on December 12 and 13 from 10 am to 5 pm, and the Fairplex Garden Railroad is open free on December 13 from 11 am to 4 pm. Our California Christmas train rides guide lists Santa trains in the region.
intro_html:
